name: A coordinator's AGENT.md: the set-up wizard writes coordinator text for an agent holding an effective coordinator grant
aliases: create a child task over HTTP
summary: The owner-visible agent record carries coordinates [{project, effective}]: the agent's coordinator grants in projects its owner is a member of, computed live, shown only to the agent's owner or a superuser signed in as a person (never to another member or to any credential, the agent's own included). web/js/agentSetup.js writes the coordinator's .orchestra/AGENT.md when one grant has effect: guidance first, never claim a worker task, then deliveries awaiting review, approved work awaiting integration, checkpoints addressed to the coordinator and quiet lanes (queue, lanes, the coordinator wait where offered); task and child creation routes with their fields, Idempotency-Key, decision headings and follow-on assignment; review, assign, comment and integration-check routes; the web-worker and other-machine sentences of agent_prompts word for word, the questions sentence, and that text is data. Its setup prompt names the extension's coordinator role; every other agent gets the worker's AGENT.md unchanged. The text is exported for Orchestra Bridge parity.
